instruction: Using Visual Studio Code, create a Python script named `hn_frontpage_scraper.py` in the `/home/user/analysis_results/hn_scraper/` directory. In this script: (1) At the start and then once every hour for 24 hours, load the website `https://news.ycombinator.com/` and scrape all front-page posts, extracting the `title`, `score` (points), and `submission_time` for each post. (2) Store each hour’s results into a SQLite database named `hn_posts.db` with a table `posts` having columns: `timestamp_scraped`, `title`, `score`, `submission_time`. (3) After the 24-hour period completes, query the database to compute the most common keywords across all titles (you may split on whitespace, lower-case, remove common stopwords). Also compute for each keyword its average post score. (4) Produce a horizontal bar chart of the top 20 keywords by count with colour intensity representing average score, and save it as `hn_keyword_score.png` in the same directory. (5) Save a text file named `hn_keyword_summary.txt` containing exactly one line formatted as: `Top20_Keywords_AverageScores: <keyword1>=<avg_score1>,<keyword2>=<avg_score2>,...`.
